Zebra Technologies

Zebra Design System

An enterprise utility language: calm, precise and built for frontline workers who scan screens quickly, often on rugged handhelds, with gloves on or in bad light. Cool-neutral greys, one confident Zebra Blue, hairline borders and IBM Plex Sans.

paletteSingle blue accent lightbulbLight · dark · AAA check_circleWCAG AA / AAA

Colour

Semantic colour tokens by family. Values shown are live: switch Dark or AAA contrast in the header and every swatch re-resolves through the same token name.

Typography

IBM Plex Sans throughout. Display sizes use the light weight; titles and labels use medium. Headings h1–h6 alias heading-large … title-small.

Spacing, shape & depth

Everything snaps to the 4px grid unit. Every component is rounded by default; the AAA contrast modes make every component sharp, except true circles such as a radio ring, switch track or avatar. Depth comes from hairline borders and very soft cool-grey shadows.

Commit Bar

The pinned footer of a page, pane or sheet that commits its changes: an optional scope statement, Cancel, then the primary at the trailing end. A destructive action sits apart at the leading end.

Draft. New component; measurements are provisional until confirmed in Figma.

Comms Buttons

Round call-control buttons: an Icon Button (large, shape full) with a phone, video, mute or speaker icon. Flavour follows the action: positive to answer, negative to end, outline-subtle for neutral actions and toggles that are off, primary for toggles that are on.

With actions · presence on and off

Without actions

Presence is written in the secondary line (Online / Away / Offline); the status badge is a bonus, never the only signal. Action buttons are large icon buttons so they clear --contact-list-item-action-size-min. Forced hover, pressed and focus states are shown under Chat List Item.

Dropdown Menu

A floating panel of Menu Items that opens from a Button or Icon Button. Click a trigger to open it; arrow keys move between rows; Escape or an outside click closes it. Rows are icon, check or custom Menu Items, never checkboxes or radios; groups are split by a divider; the panel never scrolls (longer lists are a Combobox).

Dropdown Menu · triggers (interactive)

Dropdown Menu · position × align (static, open)

The template reserves only the trigger's space; the open panel sits the panel offset away on the chosen side and overlaps what is below.

Empty State

Explains why an area is empty and what to do next, with at most one primary and one secondary action. Pick a type to see the copy change; all types share one layout.
